name: Extraordinary Kids Therapy Therapeutic Summer Camp
description_short: A therapeutic summer day camp run by a pediatric therapy practice, open to children of all abilities. It offers full-day and half-day options, and each week has a theme that guides therapy and activities.
refund_policy_summary: Once staff accept your application, you pay a $50 non-refundable deposit for each week you register. No other refund terms are stated.
special_needs_notes: This is a therapeutic camp run by a pediatric therapy practice. Weekly themes "guide our treatment, activity planning, and special events," and the camp describes itself as an inclusive environment for children of all abilities.

warnings: The page only shows the summer 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is listed.
The 2026 weeks were left as 'unknown' availability because the season has passed. Weeks 1 and 11 were not marked full on the page.
Weekly themes are listed separately from the week dates, so themes were not assigned to weeks.
Registration is by email to frontdesk@extraordinarykidstherapy.net (mailto links). There is no online registration URL.
The camp page is run by a pediatric therapy clinic. Full-day enrollment is capped at 20 children per week.
